why_it_matters: The address is probe-readable, removable and writable; nothing yet shows who dereferences it. A head whose attention follows the written address, and without which the switch falls, puts the dereference in hand at the head level; on the 27B, as on the 9B, three of four layers are Gated DeltaNet, so a null here may only say "not in full attention".

decision_rule: Fixed in advance (jobs/c3/batch49.yaml, 49.7, with amendment 2, Dan 28 Oct ~14:20). Read half, decisive query site the last token (the question tokens' mean beside, the same rules), cluster bootstrap over bridge entities (10,000, seed 0), EPS 1e-9 at the bars. move = (mass on slot k's sentence - mass on slot j's) under the arm minus the same under none, per head and (item, k); j = the bridge item's slot, k = the written slot; a sentence's mass = all its tokens. "The attention follows the address": on the pairs where the lookup switched to slot k's locker under the swap, >= 1 of the five candidate heads has mean move >= 0.30 with its CI excluding 0, its mean move under the random vector on the same pairs <= 0.05, and its mean move on the non-switched swap pairs <= 0.10. "Dereference elsewhere": the switch share >= 0.3 and no recorded head (every full-attention layer > L, every head) reaches a mean move of 0.15 on the switched pairs. Otherwise neither. (1) Aggregate, beside the per-head rule: the summed move over the five candidates and over every head of the best head's layer; "distributed dereference" if either sum >= 0.30 while no single candidate reaches 0.30. (2) Necessity: the best head (chosen on the fit half before the ablation runs) has its output (its slice of o_proj's input) zeroed at the last token, and separately at the question tokens, under the swap on the read half; "the head carries the position route" if the switch to slot k falls by >= 0.5 of its swap value while the identity answers (read pairs answering slot j's locker under the swap) change <= 0.10 and the recall's answer changes <= 0.10 (swap + zero vs swap); the clean answers lost (none + zero vs none) beside. (3) Weights-level, descriptive: S[k, k'] = (W_Q mu^q_k)^T (W_K mu^src_k') for the best head, mu^q_k = the mean last-token attention input (post input-norm) over items whose picked item is in slot k, mu^src_k' = the mean over items of the mean input at slot k''s locker-sentence tokens, unedited; diagonal dominance = (mean diagonal - mean off-diagonal) / SD of the off-diagonal; RoPE and the q/k norms left out (said so); the actual mean attention logits on slot j's / k's / the third sentence's tokens under none / swap / random beside. (4) The 9B caveat applies here too: if "elsewhere" holds (three of four layers are Gated DeltaNet), the verdict writes "the dereference is not in full attention on this model" and Muse decides.
